look: Zoom out: One continuous pull-back from a single bolt out to the turning globe. Plain: flat cut shapes with a lit side and a shadow side, under one amber work lamp from the upper left.

scenes.name: One part
scenes.desc: Close on a single bolt; the title sets in as the view pulls back to the whole wheel.

scenes.name: Parts snap
scenes.desc: The pull-back continues as a chassis, body, door and second wheel click onto the wheel to make a car.

scenes.name: The street
scenes.desc: Further out, the car sits on a street where building modules stack up and street lights switch on.

scenes.name: The city
scenes.desc: The block shrinks into a skyline on a curving horizon, windows lighting as more parts arrive.

scenes.name: The world
scenes.desc: The horizon closes into a slowly turning globe dotted with lights; the end card asks who wants to build a part.
